resources.string: On from %1$s to %2$s every day. A manual toggle lasts until the next switch time.
On from sunset (%1$s today) to sunrise (%2$s) every day. A manual toggle lasts until the next switch time.
Follows sunset and sunrise in %3$s (today %1$s to %2$s). Worked out on the device.
Follows sunset and sunrise in %3$s. The sun doesn\'t set or rise there today, so it uses %1$s to %2$s.
Pick a city, or use your current location below.
Looks up your approximate location once, over Wi-Fi or mobile network (no GPS). Nothing runs in the background.
Couldn\'t get a location. For quick Wi-Fi lookups, turn on Settings → Location → Location services → Google Location Accuracy, or pick a city above.
Update when the time zone changes
When you travel and the clock moves to a new time zone, looks up your location once. No tracking or polling.
Unavailable while OS Theme Injection is on, because the Theme Mode tile owns the system theme.
CPU/GPU tuning with AutoTDP (on by default), custom fan curve, OSD and per-app profiles. Opens on the top screen.
Turns off Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and background services while the device sleeps and restores them on wake. Opens on the top screen.
System-wide JamesDSP audio with Joey\'s Retro Handhelds preset, and display colour saturation for both screens. Opens on the top screen.
This build\'s built-in apps and display toggles (on by default)
Open PULSE (CPU/GPU tuning, AutoTDP, fan curve) on the top screen
Open ThorTune (JamesDSP audio and display saturation) on the top screen
Open SleepManager (radios and services off while asleep) on the top screen
